# NW Natural

> NW Natural provides reliable natural gas utility services across the Pacific Northwest with account management, billing, energy efficiency programs, and customer support.

NW Natural is a major natural gas utility serving Oregon and Washington. The site offers comprehensive customer tools for account management, bill payment, service requests, and energy savings programs, with a focus on affordability, efficiency, and renewable natural gas initiatives.

## Key Topics

- natural gas utility
- account management
- bill payment
- energy efficiency
- payment assistance
- renewable natural gas
- home heating
- auto-pay
- bill discount program
- income-qualified assistance
- natural gas appliances
- thermostat rewards
- weatherization programs
- cost savings
- Oregon and Washington service areas

## Account & Billing Management

- [Pay my natural gas bill](https://www.nwnatural.com/account/pay-my-bill): Multiple payment methods and bill payment options via Paymentus
- [Understanding My Bill](https://www.nwnatural.com/account/understanding-my-bill): Guide to reading bills, rate structure, and bill components
- [View payment and bill history](https://www.nwnatural.com/account/payment-bill-history): Access payment history and past bills through customer portal
- [Manage billing options](https://www.nwnatural.com/account/manage-billing-options): Manage paperless billing, auto-pay, Smart Energy, and payment plans
- [Start, Stop or Transfer Service](https://www.nwnatural.com/account/start-stop-transfer): Online service requests for starting, stopping, or transferring gas

## Payment Assistance & Affordability Programs

- [Payment assistance options for your natural gas bill](https://www.nwnatural.com/account/payment-assistance): Payment plans and assistance programs for qualifying customers
- [NW Natural Bill Discount Program](https://www.nwnatural.com/account/bill-discount-program): Income-qualified bill discounts (15-40%) and energy assistance programs
- [Free weatherization, assistance to lower energy bills](https://www.nwnatural.com/ways-to-save/savings-programs): Weatherization programs and low-income energy efficiency assistance

## Energy Efficiency & Savings

- [Rebates, offers and incentives](https://www.nwnatural.com/ways-to-save/rebates-offers): Rebates and incentives for high-efficiency appliances and equipment
- [Tips to manage and lower energy bills and reduce gas use](https://www.nwnatural.com/ways-to-save/manage-energy-use): Energy efficiency tips and recommendations for lowering gas bills
- [Thermostat Rewards](https://www.nwnatural.com/thermostatrewards): Smart thermostat rewards program for natural gas heating customers

## Services & Equipment

- [Request a tune-up for your natural gas appliances](https://www.nwnatural.com/services/inspections-tune-ups): Appliance tune-up services for energy efficiency and maintenance
- [Upgrade to high-efficiency natural gas appliances and equipment](https://www.nwnatural.com/services/appliances-equipment): High-efficiency natural gas appliances including furnaces and water heaters
- [Schedule an Inspection](https://www.nwnatural.com/services/inspections-tune-ups/schedule-inspection): Schedule free annual gas appliance and equipment inspections online

## Business & Company Information

- [Reliable. Comfortable. Convenient. - NW Natural](https://www.nwnatural.com): NW Natural homepage with account management, payments, and service options
- [Choose natural gas for your business](https://www.nwnatural.com/business): Business natural gas services, incentives, and commercial solutions
- [NW Natural - We Grew Up Here](https://www.nwnatural.com/about-us): Company overview, sustainability, ethics, and ESG reporting
